arguments.code:
import math
r=5.5
shaft = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(r).extrude(90)
head = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=90).polygon(6,18.5).extrude(5.5)
pitch=1.5
path=cq.Wire.makeHelix(pitch,30,r)
cutter=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(r+0.2,-0.65),(r-0.75,0),(r+0.2,0.65)]).close().sweep(path,isFrenet=True)
result = shaft.cut(cutter).union(head)
arguments.label: Hex bolt with helical end thread

path=cq.Wire.makeHelix(pitch,28.5,r)

result = shaft.cut(cutter).union(head)
